note: BAWAG's two credit cards, read 2026-10-30 from their pages and their standard European consumer credit information (as of August 2025): the Kreditkarte WEISS (2.06 euros a month with an account billed monthly; 24.94 a year with one billed quarterly) and Kreditkarte GOLD (5.66 a month; 68.59 a year), written at the monthly figure. A monthly balance paid in instalments bears 12.15% a year on either, the ECB's main refinancing rate plus 10 points. Each: a cash withdrawal costs 3% (at least 3.63 euros); spending in euros outside the EEA or in another currency 1.5%; each reminder or dunning letter for a payment in arrears 4.65 euros, written as the late fee. The monthly instalment is the percentage or fixed sum agreed, at least 100 euros: no share is fixed, so no minimum is written. The 6-euro charge for setting up instalments and the extra-card fees aren't written. The main banks: Erste Bank und Sparkassen, Raiffeisen and BAWAG; only BAWAG's card terms were read on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Kreditkarte WEISS (2026-10-29) holds and is kept. Raiffeisen Bank International, which issues the Raiffeisen credit cards through its Raiffeisen Card Service, was added in wave 4 as the second bank, standing for the Raiffeisen group: its price and service list for the credit card (Stand Jänner 2025, the copy its card service site serves on 2026-10-30), read 2026-10-30. The Classic, Gold and Platinum cards cost 21.40, 70.33 and 122.31 euros a year for the main card (for new customers from 1 January 2025) and 20 euros once to activate, written as the issue fee; each monthly bill is due 3 days after its date (21 on the Platinum, if chosen) and is paid in full, so nothing is carried; default interest is 4.00% a year, written as the penalty rate; a transaction in a currency other than the euro costs 1.35%, and a cash withdrawal 3% plus 0.35 euros. The list says the bank would offer new customers a consumer-price adjustment of these fees from 1 April 2026; no later list was found, so the January 2025 figures are written. Erste Bank und Sparkassen's cards are issued by card complete, whose card pages (read 2026-10-30) give the Classic, Gold and Platinum cards' monthly fees (5.50, 6.70 and 11.55 euros after the first year) but not how the balance is settled or any rate, and the card complete conditions found by search are no longer at their address (404), so no card complete card is written; Bank Austria's card price sheet refused the request by IP reputation (403); Advanzia's Austrian page wasn't at its address (404) and Santander Consumer Bank Austria's answered with a captcha.
